# Coming next (delivered as zip updates in Settings > App update)
Features that only change the app screens can arrive as a zip. Features that need Android changes will say so and need one APK build.
1. Face unlock for the lock screen (zip).
2. Offline PDF engine: keep a copy after the first use (zip).
3. Backup file that also includes photos, music and other files (zip).
4. More translated screens, including inside the apps (zip).
5. Sign in with Google (needs a Google Cloud project you create; I will guide you).
6. Browser extras that need Android changes: popups for sign-in windows and file uploads (APK build).
7. Keeping web apps alive after Android closes BrowOS from the recent-apps list (APK build, needs a larger change).
8. Not possible in this kind of app: running other Android apps (APK files) inside BrowOS without installing them, and running Windows .exe files like Roblox. A retro-games player with on-screen controls (for game files you own) could be built instead.
